qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/raw-evidence-index.json (run_golden.sh and six results/*.json hashes recomputed and matching; hosted-run artifacts and screenshots not opened)
evidence: All five dimension prompts open the live app with the browser tool on line 1: 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:1, tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:1, tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:1), matching the template's opening sentence. Every judge.toml wires a playwright MCP server (command playwright-mcp, headless chromium), so the tool the prompts name exists. Source scoring is excluded: render:1 'Use only rendered browser behavior'; constraints:1 'Use only rendered browser behavior and the live DOM' and :5 'decide it from the listed DOM facts only, not from file names, bundled library names or how the code looks'; functional:20 'do not read implementation files to infer success'; polish:17 and visual:18 'do not read implementation files'. Memory scoring is excluded: functional:9 and polish:9 'A criterion passes only on evidence you gathered yourself in this session for that criterion. If you did not perform a step, that step did not pass'; functional:12 'Never fabricate a pass'; visual:11 'Score from screenshots and the rendered page you observed yourself in this session'. First-paint scoring is excluded: the render gate criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:23) requires clicking into the editor, typing a word with real keys and reloading; the scored prompts each carry a global gate that requires typed text to appear in the editor (functional:5, polish:5, visual:5); visual:12 requires entering a ten-line draft, pressing Run, double-click selecting a word and watching the caret before screenshots. All 54 criteria (1 render, 2 constraints, 42 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) are phrased as browser actions with readbacks; a scan for source-only demands (SQLite, React, TypeScript, package.json, /app paths, bundle contents) found none, and the constraints criterion cw_custom_document_surface is decided from the live DOM after typing, which is browser evidence. Adversarial tries: (a) a static screenshot-like shell that looks right at first paint fails the render gate and every scored global gate because typing must appear; (b) an app whose source bundles a ready-made editor cannot be passed or failed from source, only from live DOM root markers; (c) a conforming canvas-drawn editor is not forced into source reading, since app_context.md:28 directs the judge to screenshots. Limitation, not a defect of this row: no configured judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), so judge compliance with these directions is unmeasured here; the row is about prompt content and is verified statically.
